text.tspan: Calls go DOWN until the base case. Then answers come back UP. Nothing returns until the bottom is reached.
Every recursive function needs two things
1. A BASE CASE that returns without
2. A step that moves CLOSER to it:
Miss either one and every call adds
another frame until the engine gives up:
Recursion shines where the DATA is nested: a folder tree, a DOM
subtree, a JSON document. For a flat list, a loop is
simpler and cannot blow the stack. Each pending call holds a
real stack frame, which is why depth, not total work, is the limit.
